summary: Display-only event ticket with attendee details and a QR slot provided by the consumer.
whenToUse: Showing an issued ticket and the details needed at the entrance.
whenNotToUse: Creating tickets, QR codes, or scanning flows.

props.name: ticketCode
props.description: Code already assigned by the consumer.

props.name: qrVisual
props.description: QR visual generated and passed in by the consumer; it is not created here.

keyboard.action: Reaches any interactive controls provided in the QR visual.

accessibility: The details are structured in a description list; the optional QR visual is placed in a slot provided by the consumer.
responsive: Details are laid out in adaptive columns; the code block moves below the content on narrow screens.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens and className on the container.
commonMistakes: Provide the QR visual from a consumer-side generator; the component neither creates nor validates codes.
limits: No issuing, downloading, or QR generation.
